description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning a noncreature artifact with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the artifact enters, Grinding Station and Clever Impersonator trigger, untapping themselves.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Clever Impersonator and the noncreature artifact returned in step 1, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the noncreature artifact, causing a player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

uses.name: Clever Impersonator
uses.cardState: as a copy of Grinding Station
